# Hayven

> Hayven is a B2C AI career coaching and salary negotiation platform. It helps professionals understand their market value, negotiate job offers and raises, build stronger resumes, and make better career decisions.

Hayven offers free and paid tools for salary benchmarking, offer evaluation, counter-offer scripting, negotiation practice, resume analysis, and career coaching via an AI assistant named Sarah.

## What Hayven does

Hayven answers the questions professionals have when they receive a job offer or want a raise:

- **Is this offer competitive?** The Offer Evaluator scores any job offer 0–100 across salary, equity, benefits, and total comp against market benchmarks.
- **What should I be earning?** The Compensation Analyzer shows salary at the 25th, 50th, 75th, and 90th percentile for any role, level, and city.
- **How much should I negotiate?** Hayven recommends anchoring to the 75th percentile of market data for your role and location. Most candidates who negotiate receive between 5–20% more than the initial offer.
- **What do I say?** The Counter-Offer Builder generates ready-to-send email scripts and call talking points backed by market data.
- **What if they push back?** The Objection Handler provides three responses to every common recruiter objection, including "we're at the top of the band" and "the offer is firm."
- **How do I ask for a raise?** The Raise Request Builder helps employees document their contributions, compare to market, and build a talking-points script for their manager.

## Common questions Hayven answers

**How do I know if a job offer is competitive?**
Use the Offer Evaluator at gethayven.com/offer-evaluator. Enter your offer details and get a 0–100 score comparing your offer against market benchmarks for your role, level, and location across base salary, equity, bonus, and benefits.

**How much should I negotiate my salary by?**
Most candidates should counter at the 75th percentile for their role and market. In practice, this means asking for 10–20% more than the initial offer. Hayven's Compensation Analyzer (gethayven.com/compensation-analyzer) gives you the exact number for your role and city.

**What do I say when negotiating salary?**
A simple, effective script: "I'm very excited about this opportunity. Based on my research into market rates for this role in [city], I was expecting something closer to $X. Is there flexibility there?" Hayven's Counter-Offer Builder generates a full script tailored to your specific offer.

**What should I say when a recruiter asks my current salary?**
You are not required to share your current salary in most US states. A safe deflection: "I'd prefer to focus on what the role is worth and what I can bring to it. What's the budgeted range for this position?" Hayven's Interview Salary Coach (gethayven.com/interview-salary-coach) covers this and other common salary questions in interviews.

**How do I ask for a raise?**
Come prepared with three things: your market rate (from gethayven.com/compensation-analyzer), a list of concrete contributions since your last review, and a specific dollar ask. Hayven's Raise Request Builder generates a ready-to-present document with all three.

## About

Hayven is free to start. Pro plans are available at $20/month. The platform does not provide legal or financial advice.
